//: Shared compiler options. Every package extends this file and adds only `include`.
Packages resolve each other through their own `exports`: workspace symlinks make them
ordinary dependencies, so a separate path list would be a second truth about the same
Core subsystems are listed by name rather than by a `lanka/*` pattern: a pattern would
resolve a deep path into any core file, so typecheck would accept an import the runtime
No `baseUrl`: it makes the bare specifier `vite` resolve to the package's own `vite/`
FOLDER, so `import type { Plugin } from "vite"` silently picks up the wrong module.
TypeScript 5 resolves `paths` relative to this file.
